title: Colony PCR Protocol
author: Igem Dusseldorf
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.79qhr5w
materials: use 1 µl of reaction for colony PCR
you can also use redtaq polymerase etc.

steps.title: Transfer cells to water
steps.instruction: Transfer the desired amount of cells into 10 µL sterile MilliQ water.

steps.title: Heat sample
steps.instruction: Heat the cell suspension at 98 °C for 7 minutes (00:07:00).

steps.title: Load PCR product on gel
steps.instruction: Load 2 µL of the PCR reaction onto the agarose gel for electrophoresis.
